Implementation Plan I'm Opus 5.5, and this is the implementation plan for issue P4 / release-blocker Phase 2a, read from the planning ref and checked against it. **Planning ref:** `orchestrator/project-8291` @ `3944e2c9c768252883484f7e3eaaad94f1df5cd2` (integration branch mismatch: false). The design source is `docs/plans/release-blocker-heal-reports-plan.md`, Phase 2, steps 10, 11 and 13 plus the auto-release half of step 14. This issue covers only the `auto_release_stable.sh` reporters. The `promote_main_cycle.sh` reporters (Phase 2) and the poller reporters (Phase 3) are separate sibling issues of the same project, so they are not deferred scope here. ### Automation / §20.E - **What changes:** an existing script is extended (`scripts/auto_release_stable.sh`). No new script, workflow or supervisor. - **Where it runs:** `.github/workflows/auto-release-stable.yml`, job `release-check`, on its existing schedule (`cron: "30 */6 * * *"`) and on `workflow_dispatch`. - **New supervisor:** none. The existing 6-hourly schedule is the trigger. - **DB work:** none. The only state is GitHub issue comments, and the heal intake (Phase 1, already on the ref) owns dedup and throttling. - **Removal registry:** no new entry. The existing `scripts/auto_release_stable.sh` + `.github/workflows/auto-release-stable.yml` entry in `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` gets one more preflight check. ## Files likely to change - `scripts/auto_release_stable.sh` - `.github/workflows/auto-release-stable.yml` - `tests/test_auto_release_stable.py` - `README.md` - `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` - `agents.d/stuck-states-p4-rb-auto-release-reporters.md` (new) - `changelog.d/stuck-states-p4-rb-auto-release-reporters.md` (new) ## Functions or modules to implement Scope-mode: Hold Scope Reuse-audit: extends workflow_failure_heal.py build-blocker-payload Scope-mode justification: This child issue delivers exactly the three `auto_release_stable.sh` reporters (`last_gate_failed`, `release_in_flight`, `stable_release_stale`) that Phase 2 of the release-blocker plan assigns to that producer. That includes the workflow env rows, the Telegram bindings, tests, docs and the registry update. Phase 1 is already on the ref, so the payload builder (`build-blocker-payload`), the dispatch envelope (`wrap-dispatch`) and the OIDC identity (`request-report-identity`) are reused rather than re-implemented. The send sequence is copied from the dispatch block in `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_phase_report.sh`. Using data the tick already fetches (the tag object, the compare response) instead of a new `releases` call is the more complete option at no extra cost: it adds zero API calls and gives a more accurate age. Per §6 (Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed), that wins over the shortcut. **1. `scripts/auto_release_stable.sh` — configuration** (next to the existing `AUTO_RELEASE_STABLE_*` defaults; every name was checked with `git grep` and none exists yet) - New variables and defaults: - `RELEASE_BLOCKER_HEAL_ENABLED` (`true`) - `RELEASE_BLOCKER_GATE_FAILED_MIN_AGE_SECS` (`86400`) - `RELEASE_BLOCKER_IN_FLIGHT_MIN_AGE_SECS` (`21600`) - `RELEASE_BLOCKER_STABLE_STALE_SECS` (`86400`) - `RELEASE_BLOCKER_HEAL_PY` (`${SCRIPT_DIR}/workflow_failure_heal.py`) - Each threshold must match `^[0-9]+$`. A bad value falls back to its default with a `::warning::` and never exits 1, because the reporter must not fail the tick. (`AUTO_RELEASE_STABLE_MAX_ATTEMPTS` keeps its fail-fast behaviour.) - Source the Telegram helper the same way as the existing `gh_helpers.sh` line: `source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/tg_helpers.sh" 2>/dev/null || true`, with a no-op fallback if `tg_send_msg` is missing. - Extend the header comment: three new log lines, the new env vars, and the API-call budget (at most one extra `POST repos//dispatches` per tick; no extra reads). **2. `release_blocker_age_from_iso `** - Prints `floor(now - fromdateiso8601)`, clamped at 0, using `jq -rn`. - Prints nothing for a missing or unparseable timestamp. Callers treat empty as "age unknown". **3. `report_release_blocker [failed_run_id]`** - Always returns 0. Call sites use `report_release_blocker … || true` and every internal step is guarded with `if !`. - Steps: 1. If `RELEASE_BLOCKER_HEAL_ENABLED` is not truthy (reuse `is_truthy`), log `RELEASE_BLOCKER_REPORT_SKIPPED reason=disabled blocker=` and return. 2. Run `python3 "${RELEASE_BLOCKER_HEAL_PY}" build-blocker-payload` with: - `--repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"` - `--workflow-name "${GITHUB_WORKFLOW:-Auto release stable}"` - `--reason `, `--evidence-file `, `--age-secs ` - `--head-branch "${AUTO_RELEASE_STABLE_BRANCH}"`, `--head-sha "${branch_tip}"` - `--run-id `, only for `last_gate_failed` - `--reporter-run-id "${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-}"`, `--reporter-run-attempt "${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"` - `--reporter-run-url "${GITHUB_SERVER_URL:-https://github.com}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"`, only when `GITHUB_RUN_ID` is numeric 3. If `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL` is set, run `request-report-identity --out <0600 tmp>`. Keep only the sanitised first status line in the log. 4. Run `wrap-dispatch --payload-json

[--report-identity-file ]`. 5. If step 2 or 4 fails, log `RELEASE_BLOCKER_REPORT_SKIPPED reason=payload_invalid blocker= stage=build|wrap`. 6. Send with `gh_retry gh api -X POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/dispatches" --input `. On failure, log `RELEASE_BLOCKER_REPORT_SKIPPED reason=dispatch_denied blocker= detail=` plus a `::warning::`. 7. On `payload_invalid` or `dispatch_denied`, call `tg_send_msg "Release blocker report could not be dispatched (): on . Refs #8291" WARNING`. 8. On success, log `RELEASE_BLOCKER_REPORTED reason= age= branch= sha= run_ref=`. - Clean-up: a `trap` (or explicit `rm -f`) removes the identity token, payload and envelope temp files on every path. The token is never printed. **4. Hooks** (no `AUTO_RELEASE_*` line, exit code or `GITHUB_OUTPUT` value changes; the reporter is always called before the existing `skip_release`, `gh workflow run` or `AUTO_RELEASE_DISPATCHED` line) - **`release_in_flight`** (before `skip_release release_in_flight`, about line 180): - Run one jq over `runs_json`, `promote_runs_json` and `legacy_runs_json` (no new calls). Select the oldest active run (same status set as the existing count) by `run_started_at // created_at`, keeping its id, status, start time and source workflow file. - If its age is at least `RELEASE_BLOCKER_IN_FLIGHT_MIN_AGE_SECS`, report with no `--run-id`. The run URL goes in the evidence only. - If no age can be parsed, log `RELEASE_BLOCKER_REPORT_SKIPPED reason=guard_unavailable blocker=release_in_flight lookup=run_started_at`. - **`last_gate_failed`** (inside the budget-spent branch, before `skip_release last_gate_failed`): - From `runs_json`, take the newest failed run on the tip (the same filter and `sort_by(.created_at) | last` as the existing `last_conclusion_on_tip`) and read its `id` and `updated_at`. - If the age since `updated_at` is at least `RELEASE_BLOCKER_GATE_FAILED_MIN_AGE_SECS`, report with `--run-id `. The id must match `^[0-9]+$`; if not, report without it. - If `updated_at` is missing, log `guard_unavailable lookup=updated_at`. There is no fallback to `created_at`, which would overstate the age. - **`stable_release_stale`**: evaluated by `release_blocker_check_stale` in three places, and only when no other blocker reported this tick (at most one report per tick): - on the `release_in_flight` path when that reporter did not fire, - on the `last_gate_failed` path when that reporter did not fire, - just before `gh workflow run` on the dispatch path, after which the normal dispatch continues. The calculation: - `pending_since = max(tag_time, oldest_unreleased_commit_date)`. - `tag_time` is the annotated tag object's `.tagger.date`, or the compare response's `base_commit.commit.committer.date` for a lightweight tag. - `oldest_unreleased_commit_date` is the minimum `.commits[].commit.committer.date` from the compare response. - Report when `now - pending_since >= RELEASE_BLOCKER_STABLE_STALE_SECS`. - When the tag is missing (no compare ran) or no date parses, log `RELEASE_BLOCKER_REPORT_SKIPPED reason=guard_unavailable blocker=stable_release_stale lookup=tag_time` and do not report. **5. Data capture, without new calls** - **Tag object (line 130):** capture the `git/tags/` response in a variable. Extract the commit sha with the same `jq -e … select(test("^[0-9a-f]{40}$"))`, keeping the `guard_unavailable lookup=tag-object:` exit on failure, and also extract `.tagger.date` (may be empty). - **Compare (line 151):** replace the status-only jq with one jq that emits three TSV fields: `.status // ""`, the minimum commit `committer.date`, and `base_commit.commit.committer.date`. The large JSON is never held in a shell variable. The `case "${compare_status}"` logic stays byte-for-byte the same. **6. Evidence file contents** (the first line is a fixed token, so the fingerprint stays stable across ticks) - Line 1: `reason=`. - Then lines such as `branch=stable tip= tag= tag_commit=`, `age_secs= threshold_secs=`, and per reason: - `gate_run=//actions/runs/ conclusion= updated_at= attempts= max=` - `active_run= workflow= status= started_at=` - `pending_since= tag_time= oldest_unreleased_commit= last_gate_on_tip= conclusion=` - Every API-derived value is filtered with `tr -cd` to safe characters before it is written. URLs are built from validated numeric ids, never copied from `html_url`. **7. `.github/workflows/auto-release-stable.yml`** - Ad
